notes: EP: the genome-wide promoter capture Hi-C sample EP_genomewide.chinput on the CHiCAGO hg19 HindIII design; K562: ENCODE K562 promoter capture Hi-C replicates 1 and 2 (HiCUP + bam2chicago on the same design). Fragment-level cools (one variable-size bin per HindIII fragment) from hicConvertFormat --inputFormat chinput, chromosomes kept with the 3.7.6 hicAdjustMatrix (derive_capture.sh). Bait-to-bait pixels hold 2N (both chinput rows summed); identical input on both sides. Target file of the 3.7.6 chicSignificantInteractions (xfold 2, p 0.01, dual).
